# Airola

> Airbnb and short-let turnover cleaning in East London, with photo proof sent to your WhatsApp after every clean.

## Services

- Standard Turnover from £45 (1-bed), +£20 per extra bedroom: kitchen, bathroom and floors, linen change and bed making (host's clean linen), bins emptied, damage and low-stock check, photo confirmation, no contract
- Premium Turnover from £65 (1-bed), +£20 per extra bedroom: everything in Standard plus dishwashing and kitchen reset, inside fridge and microwave, essentials restocked from the host's supplies, priority booking and faster response, pre-check-in double inspection
- Add-ons with Standard Turnover only: essentials restocking £10, dishwashing £10, fridge and microwave £10
- Every-turnover rate: the first clean is at the one-off price. From the second clean, save £5 per clean (£40 Standard, £60 Premium for a 1-bed), as long as each clean is booked within 30 days of the last one at the same property
- First rebook credit: rebook within 10 days of the first clean and get £10 off the second clean (instead of the £5, never combined)
- Only one offer applies per clean. Credits apply to future bookings only and cannot be exchanged for cash

## Area

Stratford, Royal Wharf, Canary Wharf, Canning Town, Hackney Wick, Bow, Mile End, Leyton

## Guarantee

First-Clean Guarantee: if the first clean is not guest-ready we re-clean the affected areas free.
